environment.description: Service deployed in isolated private subnet (no NAT, no IGW). Reachable exclusively through com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 interface endpoint with endpoint policy restricting principal to arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/InternalBatchProcessor. VPC endpoint has private DNS disabled; consumers must use the vpce-specific DNS name. Additionally, the ECS task runs with a read-only root filesystem (readonlyRootFilesystem: true in task definition) with only /tmp mounted as a 512MB tmpfs. The EXTRACT_DIR path /var/app/extracted does not exist as a writable mount — only /tmp is writable. Container uses a non-root user (UID 1000) with no CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE capability.

config.network: private subnet, no IGW, no NAT gateway, no public route
config.security_group: inbound only from VPC endpoint ENI sg-0abc123def456
